ANAGRAM.name: Anagram
ANAGRAM.description: Letters of a word or phrase are rearranged to form the answer.
ANAGRAM.indicator: Look out for words suggesting movement, change, or disorder: mix, throwing, destroy, strange, dancing, sort of, tampering with, exploded - these can all be anagram indicators.
ANAGRAM.example: Clue: 'Traps laid for tin god' → Answer: 'SNARES' (letters of 'traps' rearranged)

HOMOPHONE.name: Homophone
HOMOPHONE.description: The answer sounds like another word mentioned in the clue.
HOMOPHONE.indicator: Look for words that suggest hearing: 'so to speak', 'I hear', 'reportedly', 'on the radio'.
HOMOPHONE.example: Clue: 'Doctor wears tie, so to speak' → Answer: 'AS IT WERE'
